title: Port Forwarding
description: Forwarding binds to 127.0.0.1 only. Other local applications can connect to this address. A tunnel uses its SSH session and does not resume after restart. Connect and verify SSH first, then start it manually.
desktopOnly: Port forwarding is available in the TermVista desktop app.
addServer: Add a server in Connection Manager first.
name: Name
empty: This server has no forwarding rules yet
selectServerHint: Select a server on the left to view its forwards.
footer: The SSH server resolves and connects to the target. If a remote database accepts connections only from the server itself, use 127.0.0.1 as the target host. The local listener closes on disconnect and must be started manually after reconnecting.
startDescription: Other local apps can connect to 127.0.0.1:{{localPort}} and reach {{targetHost}}:{{targetPort}} through this SSH session. The listener is local only and is not exposed to the LAN or internet. Use only with trusted services.
deleteDescription: Delete “{{name}}”. Stop a running rule first. Deleted rules do not resume automatically.

errors.bindInUse: The local port is already in use by another application.
errors.bindFailed: Could not open the local listening port.
errors.sessionMissing: Connect over SSH before starting this forward.
errors.sessionProfileMismatch: The selected SSH session belongs to another server.
errors.connectionLost: The SSH connection was lost. The local listener is stopping.
errors.remoteRejected: The SSH server rejected the remote TCP channel.
errors.targetUnreachable: The remote target did not respond. The local listener is still running.
errors.ruleRunning: Stop the forwarding rule before changing or deleting it.

messages.loadedFailed: Could not load port forwarding rules.
messages.invalidPort: Ports must be whole numbers from 1 to 65535.
messages.stopped: Forwarding stopped and the local port was released.
messages.copyFailed: Could not copy the address. Select and copy it manually.
